title: LoggingConfig
description: What a device WILL log — the resolved profile the server pushes to one device for one session (or one test, when used as logging_config_override). The shape mirrors Capability's feature groups, but every value here MUST be implementable given the device's reported capability: the server enforces effective = intersection(plan_profile, capability) + per-device overrides (invariant 3). The UE only interprets this config; it does not negotiate. Carried with a monotonic `version` so the device can detect drift and the server can push SET_LOGGING_CONFIG when needed.

version.description: Server-assigned monotonic version of this config. The UE reports its current `logging_config_version` on every status payload; the server pushes a SET_LOGGING_CONFIG command when the device's value lags.

events.description: Event types to write live into events.parquet. Restricted to logged-live events (see enums.yaml event_type_provenance.logged_live); HANDOVER / COVERAGE_GAP / BAND_CHANGE are derived in post-processing and not configurable here.

gps.description: Whether to sample GPS into gps.parquet.

clock_calibration_interval_sec.description: Cadence of clock-calibration samples written to clock.parquet (mono / utc / optionally gps_utc tuples).

serving_cell.description: Server-selected subset of capability.radio.serving_cell. MUST be a subset of what the device reported.
